name: Rábakecöl (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rábakecöl (a green shield with a white ploughshare, ears of grain and a wavy stripe) between the years 1264 and 1995 and above the name RÁBAKECÖL in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
